## About Me

Hello! My name is Daniel Cobian, and I am a student at the University of Arkansas studying Industrial Engineering.

I am interested in problem-solving, improving processes, and learning how engineering can make everyday systems more efficient.

This e-portfolio highlights my academic projects, technical skills, and experiences as I continue developing as an engineering student.
